summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, when a local `bun` is not already present, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<triple>.zip`), unpacks it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and uses that freshly-fetched runtime to run a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the package. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, `@bun`-tagged bundle that is heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (shuffle function `WV8StW`, a large mixed numeric/string array, hex-named module-scope variables), contains no readable strings, and has no relationship to the package's stated purpose (a Rollup configuration helper). The combination — a lifecycle hook pulling an alternate language runtime and using it to execute an obfuscated bundled payload whose content is opaque to standard Node/npm supply-chain tooling — matches the alternate-runtime dropper shape and grants arbitrary code execution on the installer's host at `npm install` time. The behavior of the payload itself cannot be determined from its shipped form.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
